# Browser runtime

Locally bundled @huggingface/transformers 3.8.1 (Apache-2.0) and onnxruntime-web 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4 (MIT). License texts are included here.

Built with scripts/build-browser.mjs. WASM binaries are served from this directory; model execution does not call a hosted inference API.
